name: Tathva Cube Open 2018
information: The competition is open to all competitors. No experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the regulations and certain event-based time limits will be in place. **Steps to register on spot:** Spot registration will be open from 8:00 a.m. to 9:30 a.m. on the day of competition for events that haven't started by the time you register provided registered participants count is not 50. Please bring your ID cards for identification at the college gate. Please check information regarding payment and schedule under the respective tabs.
